alternatives.argument: Define zero sets and maximal proper z-filters directly; no theorem from the unavailable paper is used.
Compose the two locally proved bijections between maximal ideals, z-ultrafilters, and Stone–Čech points; fixed ideals are detected by common zeroes in X.
Sums of squares encode finite zero-set intersections; zero-free reciprocals prove propriety, and maximality proves the z-ideal property and the inverse constructions.
Zero-set separation proves closure-intersection identities; compactness gives a point in every z-ultrafilter closure family, and Urysohn zero-set neighbourhoods give uniqueness.
Extend the cofinite filter on N to a free ultrafilter under AC and apply the proved maximal-ideal correspondence; compactness distinguishes beta N from discrete noncompact N.
